## [1.4.2](https://github.com/6zev/morphe-patches/compare/v1.4.1...v1.4.2) (2026-11-02)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* the self-stop guard tested the branch the wrong way round ([107fea2](https://github.com/6zev/morphe-patches/commit/107fea26477184f3d809a630e30cd8cd990e32dd))

patches.name: Never stop itself
patches.description: Keeps the app from stopping its own package. Stop recent apps, Restart app and Force stop app all end in `am force-stop <package>` run over ADB, and the app is in the recents list it works from, so once an ADB connection is up the app stops itself, restarts, and loops every few seconds. The app only skips the foreground app, and only when the matching preference is enabled, so this covers what the preference does not.

patches.name: Unlock native engine
patches.description: Patches the native engine library (libd.so) so that it loads on a re-signed APK. The anti-tamper constructor that destroys a global mutex is disabled, and the trap instructions the verification routine plants inside its own code - udf #0 (SIGILL) and stores of the markers 0xdead and 0xdeadbeef (SIGSEGV) - are replaced by no-ops, leaving the routine's work intact. This is what makes Web Widget Overlay and button emulation work.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Makes the bundled Google LVL policy always report the app as licensed, which unlocks the premium features.
